page_title: LAZ 0-0 ROM | Lazio v AS Roma 12/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) attempts to test the goalkeeper after receiving a cross inside the penalty area. He hits the ball poorly and his shot goes well wide of the right post.
90+1' Renato Sanches (AS Roma) is penalised for a foul. Davide Massa had a clear view and blows his whistle. Lazio are awarded a free kick.
90+1' That will be all from Leonardo Spinazzola who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma).
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
87' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
86' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. AS Roma are awarded the free kick.
86' Here is a change. Rick Karsdorp is going off and Jose Mourinho gives the last tactical orders to Zeki Celik (AS Roma).
84' A pass from Renato Sanches (AS Roma) is intercepted by Ivan Provedel and the move breaks down.
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) for Paulo Dybala.
82' We are about to witness a substitution. Renato Sanches (AS Roma) is replacing Edoardo Bove.
82' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Daichi Kamada (Lazio) replaces Felipe Anderson.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Adam Marusic will be replaced by Elseid Hysaj (Lazio).
80' Edoardo Bove received a sweet pass from Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma), but the advance is stopped.
77' Rui Patricio leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Luis Alberto (Lazio).
75' Matias Vecino is being substituted because of an injury. Maurizio Sarri sends Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) on the pitch.
75' A player from AS Roma commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Lazio have a free kick.
74' Patric (Lazio) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.

73' Matias Vecino (Lazio) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Rui Patricio pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
73' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

72' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) attempts to find Edoardo Bove with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for AS Roma.
71' Patric (Lazio) is able to continue to play.
70' Looks like Patric (Lazio) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
69' Davide Massa blows the whistle, Ciro Immobile (Lazio) is penalised for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to AS Roma.
67' Luis Alberto (Lazio) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.

66' The game is interrupted. Adam Marusic (Lazio) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
65' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Pedro (Lazio) is replaced by Gustav Isaksen.
65' Danilo Cataldi goes off the pitch and Matias Vecino (Lazio) comes on.
64' The Lazio players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
63' A pass by Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
61' The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
58' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Ciro Immobile, but Rui Patricio displays great awareness to stop him.
57' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
56' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Lazio will take a free kick near the side line.
54' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. It's a free kick to Lazio in a dangerous position.
53' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
52' Dangerous play by Adam Marusic (Lazio). Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul. AS Roma have a free kick.
51' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
50' Davide Massa blows his whistle. Ciro Immobile (Lazio) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick is awarded to AS Roma.
50' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
48' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) meets a cross from Leonardo Spinazzola, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar.
46' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
46' Davide Massa blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Luis Alberto (Lazio) latches onto a short pass from Matteo Guendouzi inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar.
41' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
40' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Lazio earn a corner.
39' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Davide Massa and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
37' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
35' 3:8 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
33' Maurizio Sarri is stunned as referee Davide Massa shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
32' Rough tackle by Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to AS Roma.
31' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
29' A dangerous looking corner kick from Luis Alberto (Lazio) is cleared to safety by the defence.

29' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would probably have ended up in the bottom right corner, but Rui Patricio pulls off a superb reflex save and punches the ball onto the post. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
27' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) makes a slide tackle, but referee Davide Massa blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Lazio, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
25' Luis Alberto (Lazio) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close!
24' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) tries to find Pedro, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
22' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) brings his opponent down. Davide Massa has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Lazio.
22' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

20' Luis Alberto (Lazio) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
18' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Davide Massa didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
18' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) is adjudged offside.
17' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but Ivan Provedel comes off his line to gather the ball.
14' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
13' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) has a goal ruled out for offside!

12' Rick Karsdorp (AS Roma) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Ivan Provedel.
10' Luis Alberto (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
9' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) commits a foul and Davide Massa immediately signals a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Lazio.
5' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar.
2' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
2' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Ciro Immobile, but Rui Patricio displays great awareness to stop him.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Lazio will take the kick-off.
Davide Massa is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
